body:
DELIVERED. Commit 696fffaa. crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs (11,047 lines — the only workspace file over
the ~10k ceiling) split into crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational/ (12 modules), largest backend.rs = 2517 lines,
none over ~3k. Pure behavior-preserving code MOVE:
- Commit is a clean delete(relational.rs) + add(relational/*.rs); lib.rs UNTOUCHED (its `mod relational;` now
  resolves to relational/mod.rs, which reconstructs the exact public surface via pub use re-exports).
- No logic/SQL/signature/trait-impl change (verbatim line-range move). Only deltas: per-module `use` imports +
  `use super::*;`, mod.rs re-exports, and visibility WIDENED to pub(crate) (crate-INTERNAL only) for helpers/Inner/
  TokenOp/etc. so cross-module refs compile — nothing external-`pub` changed.
- Module layout: mod.rs (re-exports + ComposedSqliteRelationalBackend), helpers.rs, apply.rs (write path), query.rs
  (read/selection SQL), recovery.rs (id-high-water/checkpoint/open), backend.rs (SqliteRelationalBackend), projection.rs
  (SqliteProjectionStore), hybrid.rs (HybridProjectionStore + fault seam), checkpoint.rs, monitor.rs (HybridAsyncMonitor),
  unified.rs (SqliteRelational), group_summary_tests.rs (#[cfg(test)] verbatim).
Verification (behavior-preservation): the public API is unchanged BY CONSTRUCTION — pqueue-server / pqueue-engine /
pqueue-conformance compile UNCHANGED against it (0-failed), which they couldn't if any pub item/path had changed.
BEFORE == AFTER test counts across the heavy sqlite suite: relational_conformance 167, sqlite lib 14,
composed_relational_reconnect 8, composed_relational_terminal_reap 2, composed_commit_duplicate_unique_index 2,
hybrid_async_backpressure 13 / _chaos 10 / _checkpoint 7 / _recovery 4, engine lib 94, server lib 45 — all 0 failed,
identical to baseline (a logic change would have shifted a count). fmt clean; clippy -D warnings clean; 0 build warnings.
No file in the workspace now exceeds ~2.5k lines except by-design large test files.
summary: relational.rs (11k) split into 12 modules (largest 2517 lines) under the 10k ceiling; pure behavior-preserving move, lib.rs untouched, identical test counts, consumers compile unchanged, clippy clean
